name: MISYO Deltarune Navigation
description: A Deltarune-style custom new tab page for Microsoft Edge with Baidu, Bing, Google, and GitHub search.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.bing.com https://api.github.com https://suggestion.baidu.com https://suggestqueries.google.com; object-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
